added_failures_note: Derived from the reviewed run's own gate arms. Its manifest records baseline_suite and after_suite as empty, so the arms were taken from base-logs/, base-gate-summary.log, head-logs/ and head-gate-summary.log. Base (2669319dd, tree scratch/base): 13/13 files complete, 88 passed, 1 failed, 15 deselected; the one base failure is tests/test_contour_tree_wall_split.py::test_production_split_events_match_outside_augmented_sublevel_counts's sibling file's sweep_bounds brute-force id. Head (a0d88a04a, two docs-only commits before the reviewed head d3cb50c0b, which touch only the evidence fragment): 96 passed, 10 failed, 0 deselected. Of the 10 head failures, 9 are not added: tests/test_contour_tree_sweep_bounds.py::test_brute_force_fixture_receipts_match_recorded_fields fails identically at base and head (1 failed 1 passed, EXIT=1 in both log pairs), and the 8 tests/equilibrium/test_topology_contour_mesh_capacity.py::test_wide_wall_record_builds_below_capacity[...] ids reproduce at base in base-capacity-all-markers.log (revision 2669319dd, tree scratch/base, command with -m "slow or not slow") with the same ValueError at scripts/prototypes/efit_field_swap/trace_record.py:144. The one added failure is tests/test_contour_tree_wall_split.py::test_production_split_events_match_outside_augmented_sublevel_counts: base-logs/test_contour_tree_wall_split.log records 7 passed EXIT=0 and head-logs/test_contour_tree_wall_split.log records 1 failed, 6 passed EXIT=1.

findings.text: This node's intended removal of the spurious SOL pair reddens a peer-owned test: base-logs/test_contour_tree_wall_split.py records 7 passed EXIT=0 while head-logs/test_contour_tree_wall_split.py records 1 failed, 6 passed EXIT=1 on test_production_split_events_match_outside_augmented_sublevel_counts, the only added failure of the change; the file lies outside this node's declared write paths so it could not be repaired here, and the reviewed manifest records it under follow_ons.

The reviewed manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite keys are empty, so the reviewed run's declared gate arms are unreadable and a reader taking base-gate-summary.log (1 failed) against head-gate-summary.log (10 failed) naively derives 9 added failures where the true added set is 1; the same defect leaves the arms unreconcilable at promotion time without the supplementary base-capacity-all-markers.log.

The base arm's scratch tree has no conftest.py, so nova's markexpr override (conftest.py:36-46, which clears the inherited default '-m not slow' when a test path is named explicitly) never ran there and the default filter deselected the 8 slow tests/equilibrium/test_topology_contour_mesh_capacity.py::test_wide_wall_record_builds_below_capacity cases at base while the head arm ran them, so the two arms are not like-for-like and only the after-the-fact base-capacity-all-markers.log closes the gap.

justifications.durability: Both added assertions name a condition under which they fail: reinstating the barycentric wall flux in _clipped_carrier reddens tests/test_contour_tree_mesh.py:84 test_added_wall_vertices_match_curved_field at 48/48 wall vertices (negative-control.log, EXIT=1), and its own file also carries the retained test_nearest_centre_valuation_fails_linear_exactness, with the figure receipt pinned by tests/test_contour_tree_explanatory_figure.py:106-108 comparing the committed SVG against the receipt digest.
justifications.evidence: The done-when is measured and recorded, not claimed: the receipt at the reviewed head carries 4 nodes and 3 edges with drawn_carrier_vertices [5, 69, 457, 461] and the removed pair absent, figure-head.log records 'nodes=4 edges=3' at EXIT=0, and the receipt's svg_sha256 independently recomputes over the committed SVG with its dc:date stripped; the deduction is that the reviewed manifest leaves baseline_suite and after_suite empty, so the two gate arms are not readable from the manifest and the base arm additionally under-collected (see the scratch/base finding).
justifications.fit: The addition follows the module's existing idiom as a keyword-only optional parameter beside vertex_capacity/edge_capacity at nova/equilibrium/contour_tree_mesh.py:340 with a docstring stating its contract, and the new names (_certificate_field, field_evaluator, curved_flux) describe mechanism with no version, plan, sprint or ticket identifier and no author attribution.
justifications.goal_fidelity: The landed change does exactly what the goal states: nova/equilibrium/contour_tree_mesh.py removes _barycentric_flux and its nearest-simplex fallback entirely and assigns vertex_psi for every vertex added after the cell centres from field_evaluator (lines 372-377, `vertex_psi[len(centre_rz):] = sampled.tolist()`), keeping the supplied centre samples as given, so no caller can obtain an interpolated wall value.
justifications.reuse: No owner exists for a per-vertex point evaluator on the carrier mesh and the search over nova/equilibrium, nova/media and benchmarks found none, while the addition extends the owners it does touch: benchmarks/contour_tree_brute_force.py:65 _certificate_field wraps the existing benchmarks/solovev_certificate.py _case/_exact_state rather than forking the closed-form field, and _barycentric_flux is deleted rather than superseded in place.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 2669319dded99f086120148509b1f16f131d59c2 d3cb50c0b51492f6d1c198bb162b6da718ee2264 lists 9 changed paths and every one lies inside the node's 14 declared write paths, with no source, test or receipt touched outside them.
